cardEffects:
[When Digivolving] ＜De-Digivolve  2＞ 1 of your opponent's Digimon. (Trash up to 2 cards from the top. You can't trash past level 3 cards.) Then, if [Gankoomon] or [X Antibody] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, until the end of your opponent's turn, none of your Digimon are affected by your opponent's Digimon's effects.
[Opponent's Turn] All of your Digimon with [Sistermon] or [Huckmon] in their names or the [Royal Knight] trait gain ＜Reboot＞ (This Digimon also unsuspends in your opponent's unsuspend phase.) and ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.)
inheritedEffect: [Opponent's Turn] While this Digimon is [Jesmon GX] all of your Digimon gain ＜Reboot＞ (This Digimon also unsuspends in your opponent's unsuspend phase.) and ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.)
name: Gankoomon (X Antibody)

references.text: Official JP Q&A for BT20-059 (2025/01/24, translated by DeepL)

rulings.answer: This effect is not affected by effects. For example, "Rest an opponent's Digimon." effect will not be rested, and "DP-3000 an opponent's Digimon." will not be minus DP.
rulings.question: What is the effect of "not taking effect?"
Can a card with the "no effect" effect be selected for an effect?

rulings.answer: Yes, it can be granted. The effect is not affected, but can be granted.
rulings.question: Can a card with a "no effect" effect be given an effect?

rulings.answer: From the point of no longer being affected by the effect, it is no longer affected by the effect being granted.
rulings.question: If a card with an effect is given an effect and later gets a "no effect" effect, what happens to the effect that is given?

rulings.answer: From the time it becomes subject to the effect, it is affected by the effect being granted.
rulings.question: If a card with a "no effect" effect that is granted an effect later loses the "no effect" effect, what happens to the granted effect?

rulings.answer: No, it does not trigger. If you give an effect that triggers to a Digimon that does not receive the effect, the effect will not be triggered.
rulings.question: I added a triggering effect such as [When Attacking] effect to a card with "No Effect" effect. If the card then satisfies the conditions for triggering that effect, does the effect trigger?
